description: Project-local registry of deprecated APIs, SDK patterns, and legacy foundations that require an explicit migrate-vs-extend decision before new work builds on them.

freshness.stale_action: Refresh vendor/source evidence before adding new foundations or accepting a migrate-vs-extend decision.
freshness.first_hit_scan: Run a whole-codebase scan on the first project hit before planning implementation tasks.

foundations.title: Google Places API legacy web service endpoints
foundations.decision_required: Do not add new code against legacy Places endpoints until design-tech records whether the work migrates to Places v1 or deliberately extends the legacy surface with a bounded follow-up WI.

foundations.title: React unsafe class-component lifecycle methods
foundations.successor: React function components, hooks, or safe lifecycle alternatives
foundations.decision_required: Do not add new lifecycle behavior to unsafe class lifecycles without documenting a migrate-vs-extend decision.
